purpose: Known dates on which facts on this site go stale, and the pages each one affects. scripts/audit-freshness.mjs reads this and tells you what needs checking in the next few weeks, so a price change does not sit wrong on the site for months.
howToUse: Add an entry whenever you discover something that changes on a schedule. 'month' is when the change lands. 'leadWeeks' is how far ahead you want warning. Slugs are the pages that quote the affected figures - if you write a new page that quotes them, add it here.

events.name: TfL fares
events.what: Tube, bus, DLR and Overground fares, the daily cap and the Oyster/contactless rates. Usually announced in January and applied at the start of March.

events.name: Wimbledon ballot and ticket prices
events.what: The public ballot opens in mid-September and closes a few weeks later. Ground pass and show court prices, the Queue rules and debenture resale detail all move each spring.

events.name: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland
events.what: Dates confirmed and tickets released around October. Attraction prices, the circus line-up and timed-entry rules all change year to year.

events.name: Christmas lights, markets and ice rinks
events.what: Switch-on dates, market runs and rink seasons are announced from late September. Almost every date on the Christmas page changes annually.

events.name: Halloween and Bonfire Night
events.what: Event dates, scare-attraction runs and firework displays are confirmed through September. Most displays announce ticket prices in early October.

events.name: London Marathon ballot
events.what: The ballot for the following year opens shortly after race day in April and closes within days.

events.name: BFI London Film Festival
events.what: Programme and booking dates announced late August, festival runs in October.

events.name: Attraction admission prices
events.what: Major attractions review prices in the spring. Historic Royal Palaces, the Merlin attractions and the big galleries are the ones that move most. NOTE: a temporary government VAT cut held prices down from 25 June to 1 September 2026 and expired - anything written in that window may quote the low figure.

events.name: Immersive and cabaret shows
events.what: The highest-churn category on the site. Shows close with no notice - three major ones closed in the first half of 2026. Worth a status check every quarter rather than annually.

events.name: Restaurant and bar closures
events.what: Food guides go stale by closure rather than by price. A quarterly sweep against the consensus corpora catches the worst of it.
